title: Maximum Assisted Speed
description: Motor assistance shall stop above 25 kmh

title: Minimum Vehicle Range
description: eBike shall achieve at least 120 km range

title: Battery Thermal Protection
description: System shall disconnect charging during overtemperature

title: Motor Overcurrent Protection
description: System shall limit motor current under fault conditions

title: Brake Signal Redundancy
description: Brake activation shall be detected via dual-channel input

title: Battery State of Charge Accuracy
description: SOC estimation error shall be below 3%

title: Firmware Update Integrity
description: System shall verify firmware authenticity before installation

title: Display Speed Accuracy
description: Displayed speed shall deviate less than 2 kmh

title: Water Ingress Protection
description: System shall withstand IP67 water exposure

title: Pedal Assist Responsiveness
description: Assist torque shall respond within 200 ms

title: Bluetooth Connectivity Stability
description: System shall maintain BLE connection for 10 minutes minimum

title: Emergency Motor Shutdown
description: System shall disable motor within 100 ms on critical fault
